newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bolsa ends flat in erratic session.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bolsa ends flat in erratic session.

text.p: Argentine stocks closed flat Thursday after an erratic session that may be the pattern until the U.S. presidential polls on November 5, dealers said.

"The U.S. markets, mainly the stock market, went through strong upswings with corporate results not in line with what was expected," Jorge Bonanno of brokers Interfin said. "Those upswings may be the pattern of the Argentine bolsa until the U.S. elections."
The MerVal closed at 560.98 points, exactly equal to Wednesday. But volume fell to $15.6 million from $19.3 million.

A decline in the Dow Jones, which closed below 6,000 points, prompted a fall in Argentine ADRs which in turn swept away a 0.9 percent gain of the leading index MerVal at midsession. The MerVal had opened lower.

"The market is cautious about what will be the direction of the U.S. economy after the polls," said Marcelo Romano, analyst for brokers Lopez Leon. "Its attention is also focused on the U.S. GDP figures expected October 30."

The day's best main-tier performers were paper maker Celulosa, which jumped 3.3 percent, and power utility Central Costanera, with 3.0 percent, while the main losers were cement company Juan Minetti, with 1.6 percent decline, and Telecom down 1.5 percent.
